root_causes: Inefficient object handling: the agent placed the stuffed toy on the dining room floor (step 76) instead of transporting it toward the living room, introducing unnecessary extra pick/place cycles.

Redundant navigation: the agent navigated to generic locations (e.g., floor_dining_room_1 in step 85 and again in step 95) instead of directly planning a sequence to complete the remaining subgoal with minimal moves.

Poor multi-object coordination: after successfully placing the toy pineapple on a chair in the living room (step 93), the agent did not immediately finalize the task with the stuffed toy but instead continued with unnecessary navigation actions.
improvement_suggestions: Maintain goal-directed object holding: once an object relevant to the task is picked up, avoid placing it down in intermediate, non-target locations unless required by constraints (e.g., capacity limits or collisions).
Optimize navigation targets: plan paths that move directly between semantically relevant waypoints (object -> doorway -> target chair) rather than repeatedly navigating to generic floor regions.

Improve multi-object strategy: structure the plan so that after one object is successfully placed on a target chair, the agent immediately completes the remaining object transfer with minimal backtracking.
Incorporate cost-aware planning: penalize unnecessary pick/place and navigation operations more strongly during planning to reduce total step count and negative reward.
Add progress-aware termination checks: when all propositions are satisfied (both objects on living-room chairs), terminate instead of issuing additional navigation commands back to previous rooms.
overall_assessment: The task was ultimately completed successfully but with inefficient object handling and redundant navigation, leading to high step count and negative cumulative reward. Overall execution achieved correctness but with suboptimal efficiency and planning quality.
task_instruction: Move the stuffed toy and toy pineapple from the dining room to the living room. Place them on a chair.
